question: Which star of The Bear just filed for divorce?
story: The actress who plays Sugar on The Bear just filed for divorce, and the timeline is the part fans cannot stop talking about. Abby Elliott, who plays Natalie on the hit show, has officially split from her husband, TV producer Bill Kennedy, after nearly ten years of marriage. According to court documents obtained by TMZ, she filed on July seventeenth, citing irreconcilable differences. Here is the detail that got everyone. The papers list their actual separation date as July eighth, meaning they had quietly been apart for over a week before any of this went public. And here is the twist. These two met the cutest way possible, on the set of a 2014 movie that Bill wrote and Abby starred in. They married in 2016 and share two young kids together. Now she is asking for joint custody, closing a chapter on a love story that literally started on a film set.
